ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

2. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

3. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.

4. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

5. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.

6. When learning Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.

7. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

9. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Lamps and Lamp Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Combinational Logic Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Home- based Automatic Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Project Implementation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
